integration_issues.issue: Cashfree production modal renders 'Broken Link! https://airyatra-corporate.preview.emergentagent.com/ is not enabled or approved. Please whitelist your domain from merchant.cashfree.com > developers.' The order is created successfully (real CF_ id) but user cannot complete payment until domain whitelisting is done at merchant.cashfree.com. This is a merchant-portal config action, not a code fix.

action_items: MERCHANT ACTION (not code): Whitelist preview.emergentagent.com (and production airyatra.co.in) at merchant.cashfree.com > Developers > Domain Whitelisting (bit.ly/3XktRJJ) so the hosted checkout modal renders instead of 'Broken Link!' error. This unblocks the manual GPay approval final step.

OPTIONAL: Request S2S direct-collect approval from Cashfree so /upi-collect can send true GPay collect requests instead of falling back to hosted checkout (currently backend correctly detects s2s_enabled_not_approved and falls back — no code change needed).
critical_code_review_comments: cashfree_routes.py L451-463 — hosted_checkout fallback on 's2s' / 'feature_not_enabled' error is a good defensive pattern; keeps user flow unblocked while S2S approval is pending. Consider also matching Cashfree's specific error code 'feature_not_enabled_for_the_merchant' explicitly for stricter safety.

cashfree_routes.py L365-427 (_finalize_cashfree_payment) — idempotency via update_one with status filter + duplicate protection via cashfree_webhook_events collection is solid. Confirmed working: sending same webhook twice returns duplicate:true and does NOT double-settle.

cashfree_service.py L297-310 — webhook signature verification correctly uses CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_SECRET or client_secret fallback, standard HMAC-SHA256(base64) — matches Cashfree v3 spec. Invalid sig → 401 verified.
cashfree_routes.py L316 PAYMENT_STAFF constant duplicates the RBAC set from other route files (verticals, razorpay). Consider centralising into middleware.role_constants to avoid drift.

cashfree_service.py L295-300 — if webhook_secret is empty string, verify_webhook returns True. In production this is a risk if env var is accidentally cleared. Recommend hard-fail (return False) when ENV=production.
